name: GV Electricals Ltd
tagline: Rs ~155 Cr just-IPO'd electrical-infrastructure O&M and metering services provider to DISCOMs with ~40 years of execution history, ~77% recurring revenue, a 3.5x order-book cover and FY26 PAT that more than doubled -- but it is a competitive-bid contracting business at the least-differentiated end of the grid chain
business_overview: GV Electricals provides operation & maintenance (O&M), electrical-infrastructure development and metering services to electricity distribution utilities across India, with ~40 years of execution history and some international work. Contracts are long-term maintenance / AMC / rate contracts and project work orders won mainly through competitive bidding. Client base also spans industrial plants, government departments, commercial buildings and data centres.
fundamentals_table: ~Rs 156 Cr revenue / ~Rs 10.5 Cr PAT; PAT more than doubled YoY
ROE / ROCE described as strong; exact figures not disclosed in the sources reviewed
fundamentals_narrative: The attractive features are the ~77% recurring-revenue mix (better than a pure EPC contractor), the 3.5x order-book cover, modest leverage and a doubling of FY26 PAT indicating operating leverage. The limiting features are structural: revenue comes from competitive-bid utility contracts with no pricing power, working capital and DISCOM payment cycles are a permanent drag, and ~40 years of history has produced only a ~Rs 156 Cr revenue base -- growth has not compounded. It is a freshly listed micro-cap with no public track record and a low-quality (untrusted X) origination.
